Studied: Science.description:
🔬 You studied the sciences: physics, chemistry and biology, a lab internship or an introductory Quirk science course.

🌱 You can estimate forces, identify a chemical hazard, run a careful experiment and reason about how a Quirk might work.
⚠️ Research-level Quirk genetics, restricted studies and advanced lab work are beyond you.
⚖️ It gives no lab access and no right to experiment on people; Quirk experiments on people without consent are a serious crime.
🏫 It shows in careful measurements, hypotheses spoken aloud and a lab notebook.

📈 Grants: Science +15
Studied: Science.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has studied science: physics, chemistry, biology and the basics of Quirk science, including how Quirks are inherited and why they vary. They can estimate forces, identify a chemical hazard, run a careful experiment and reason about how a Quirk might work. Prior study, not mastery: research-level Quirk genetics, restricted studies and advanced lab work are beyond them. Not a license: it gives no lab access and no right to experiment on people; Quirk experiments on people without consent are a serious crime. It shows in careful measurements, hypotheses spoken aloud and a lab notebook.
